prompt: Partners are complaining that our API docs do not match what they get. Assess this repository and write the assessment to ASSESSMENT.md. Do not change the code or the docs.

assertions.description: The absent authentication, against docs promising it, is reported
It is rated on the security scale and separated from the documentation findings
The documented v1 paths against the served v2 paths are reported
Page-number docs against cursor pagination are reported
The documented page size against the implemented one is reported
The required but undocumented idempotency-key header is reported
The documented POST response against the actual one is reported
The documented rate limit against the configured one, and per-token against per-IP, is reported
The declared test command was run and its output recorded
Public exposure is not asserted without allowing for upstream authentication
The audited files and docs are left byte-identical
What was not examined is named rather than assumed safe
